s0.description: Prologue: the question that drives the story, and 1898, when America stepped onto the world stage.

s1.description: Act I, The Great War (1914–1918): why Europe exploded, why America joined, and how the peace planted the next war.

s2.description: Act II, Between the Wars (1919–1939): boom, crash, dictators, and the road back to war.

s3.description: Act III, World War II (1939–1945): the largest war in history and America’s role in winning it.

s4.description: Act IV, The Cold War (1945–1969): two superpowers, Korea, the brink in Cuba, and the race to the Moon.

s5.description: Epilogue: the view from the Moon, and the answer to our question.
